dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent in Cibao Nordeste Region, Dominican Republic as of 21 November 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20231120DOM, GDACS ID: 1102342** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water extent in Cibao Nordeste Region, Dominican Republic as observed from a Sentinel-2 image acquired on the 21 November 2023 at 11:17 local time. Within the cloud free analysed area of about 920 km² , about 190 km² of land appears to be affected with flood waters and 13,000 people are potentially exposed to flood waters. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
